hero.title: Welcome to Infinity Trigger
hero.description: We're crafting tools that celebrate and amplify your creative voice. Our mission is simple: put powerful, human-centered creative tools in your hands, then step back and let your imagination soar.
hero.footerLove: Made with love in Nagano Prefecture, Japan

tools.title: Our Creative Tools
tools.description: Thoughtfully designed apps that help you write, create, and tell your stories. Whether you're a writer, artist, filmmaker, or someone who loves to create, we're here to support your creative journey.

valuesPage.title: Our Values
valuesPage.description: At Infinity Trigger, we believe in creating a positive impact through our work. Our values guide everything we do.

sustainableGoals.title: Sustainable Development Goals
sustainableGoals.description: We are committed to supporting the UN's Sustainable Development Goals through our products and operations. Our focus areas include quality education, sustainable cities, and climate action.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: We believe technology should be accessible to everyone. Our products are designed with WCAG guidelines in mind, ensuring that all users can engage with our content regardless of their abilities.

diversity&Inclusion.title: Diversity & Inclusion
diversity&Inclusion.description: We celebrate diversity in all its forms. Our team and products reflect our commitment to creating inclusive spaces where everyone feels welcome and represented.

commitment.title: Our Commitment
commitment.description: These values aren't just words on a page - they're the principles that guide our decision-making, product development, and company culture. We continuously strive to improve and make a positive impact in everything we do.

about.title: About Infinity Trigger
about.descriptionParagraph1: We're a small team passionate about building creative tools that put imagination first. We celebrate and help foster creativity in all its forms.
about.descriptionParagraph2: Storytelling has always been at the very core of the human experience. From our earliest days, we've used stories to pass down wisdom, explain truths about the world, and connect with one another across generations.
about.descriptionParagraph3: At Infinity Trigger, we strive to empower people all over the world to bring their stories to life. We believe that everyone has a story to tell—and we're passionate about building tools that help people tell their stories, share their experiences, and connect with one another across generations.
about.descriptionParagraph4: We're a small team based in Nagano City, Nagano Prefecture, Japan, and we can't wait to hear your story.

identity.title: Our Identity
identity.descriptionParagraph1: At Infinity Trigger, we believe that technology should amplify, not replace, human stories. Stories have always been at the heart of how we relate to the world and to each other. Our mission is to build creative tools that amplify human creative voices, celebrating the incredible power these voices have to bring life to the world.
identity.descriptionParagraph2: Every piece of creative content in our apps has a human-centered design. Every story, every journey, every adventure is crafted by people who understand the creative process and the challenges and victories that come with it.

story.title: Our Story
story.descriptionParagraph1: Infinity Trigger started with a simple idea: to create tools that are, yes, creative, would inspire new ideas, new stories, and a relentless pursuit of quality.
story.descriptionParagraph2: From a small project based in the heart of the beautiful Nagano Prefecture, we've grown into a mission-driven team, serving a global creative community that includes artists, writers, and creators around the world.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: The principles that guide everything we do.

humanCentered.title: Human-Centered
humanCentered.description: Technology should fit around creativity—not the other way around. We build tools with a human-first approach to enhance the creative process.

celebrateCreativity.title: Celebrate Creativity
celebrateCreativity.description: Every person has a unique creative spark. We build tools to amplify that, cultivate it, and help it grow stronger with time.

authenticContent.title: Authentic Content
authenticContent.description: All of our creative content is built on the foundation of authentic human experiences, not algorithms. We support authentic, thoughtful, and user-centered storytelling.

team.title: Our Team
team.description: We are a small team with big dreams for the future of digital creative tools. We have a team of developers, designers, and content creators with a passion for advancing tools that help real people tell real stories. Many of us are creative hobbyists or professionals ourselves, and it drives us to build the tools we want to use ourselves.

cta.description: Be part of our mission to celebrate human creativity and build tools that inspire.

meanwhileCard.description: A thoughtfully designed daily writing companion that helps you develop a consistent writing practice through human-crafted prompts, streak tracking, and privacy-focused design.

hero.title: Meanwhile
hero.description: A daily writing companion designed to help you develop a consistent writing practice through thoughtful prompts, gentle encouragement, and distraction-free writing.

about.title: About Meanwhile
about.description: Meanwhile is a thoughtfully designed iOS application that helps users establish and maintain a daily writing habit.

inspiration.title: The Inspiration
inspiration.descriptionParagraph1: Many people want to write more regularly but struggle with consistency and motivation. Traditional journaling apps often lack the specific features needed to build a sustainable writing habit.
inspiration.descriptionParagraph2: We created Meanwhile with a vision for an app that would specifically focus on helping users develop a daily writing practice through gentle encouragement, thoughtful prompts, and a distraction-free writing environment.

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.description: We focused on understanding the psychology behind habit formation and what makes writing apps effective. Our approach centered on:

bulletPoints.writingEnvironment: Creating a minimalist, distraction-free writing environment
bulletPoints.reminders: Implementing gentle reminders and streak tracking to build consistency
bulletPoints.writingPrompts: Developing a library of thoughtful writing prompts to inspire users
bulletPoints.interfaceDesign: Designing an intuitive interface that gets out of the way of the writing process

features.title: Key Features
features.description: Meanwhile combines thoughtful design with practical features to make daily writing effortless.

dailyPrompts.title: Daily Prompts
dailyPrompts.description: Thoughtfully crafted writing prompts that inspire creativity and reflection, updated daily.

streakTracking.title: Streak Tracking
streakTracking.description: Build consistency with gentle reminders and motivating streak tracking.

focusMode.title: Focus Mode
focusMode.description: A distraction-free writing environment that helps you stay focused on your writing.

quickEntry.title: Quick Entry
quickEntry.description: Start writing in seconds with our streamlined interface and quick access tools.

cta.title: Start Your Writing Journey
cta.description: Download Meanwhile today and discover the joy of daily writing.

Our Privacy Policy does not cover how external third parties define 'personal data', how they collect, store, use, or share it. hero.title: Meet Our Team
hero.description1: We're a small but passionate global team, primarily based in Nagano City, Japan, dedicated to building creative tools that celebrate human imagination.
hero.description2: Each of us brings unique perspectives and skills to create tools that we, as creatives, would want to use ourselves.

tanner.name: Tanner Galloway
tanner.description: A software engineer with a passion for building responsive, user-friendly applications and websites. Responsible for localization, functionality, and code reviews.

john.name: John Appleseed

approach.title: How We Work
approach.description1: We believe in the power of small teams and big ideas. While we're a compact size, it allows us to move quickly, make decisions efficiently, and maintain the personal touch that makes our tools feel human and remain approachable.
approach.description2: Every team member wears multiple hats, bringing diverse perspectives to every project. This collaborative approach ensures that our tools are built with both technical excellence and creative insight.

values.title: What Drives Us
